title: CausalGrade: Evidence-Guided Causal Graph Scoring with Jev
abstract: arXiv:2610.40692v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating the structural quality of candidate causal graphs when the true causal structure is unknown is an important problem in applying causal discovery results. This paper proposes CausalGrade, a causal graph scoring method based on the probabilistic judgment model Jev. The method jointly provides Jev with evidence of association, conditional dependence, and directionality from observational data and edge probabilities produced by the causal discovery foundation model CDFM. Jev produces probabilistic judgments about direct causal edges, and a graph-level score is obtained by measuring the agreement between the adjacency structure of the graph under evaluation and these edge-level judgments. translated_title: CausalGrade：基于Jev的证据引导因果图评分方法
translated_abstract: 在真实因果结构未知的情况下，评估候选因果图的结构质量是应用因果发现结果时的一个重要问题。本文提出了CausalGrade，一种基于概率判断模型Jev的因果图评分方法。该方法将观测数据中提供的关联性、条件依赖性和方向性证据，以及由因果发现基础模型CDFM产生的边概率共同提供给Jev。Jev对直接因果边给出概率性判断，并通过衡量被评估图的邻接结构与这些边级判断之间的一致性，得到图层面的评分。在300个合成数据集上的实验表明，该评分在四种因果发现算法与五种变量数量的全部20种组合中均与结构误差呈现较强的负相关，说明分数越高通常对应着结构误差越小、因果图越准确。
tldr: 提出基于概率判断模型Jev的因果图评分方法CausalGrade，通过融合观测数据证据与因果发现基础模型CDFM的边概率对候选因果图进行评分，评分与结构误差呈强负相关，可在真实因果结构未知时评估因果图质量。
en_tdlr: CausalGrade is a Jev-based causal graph scoring method that combines evidence from observational data with edge probabilities from the causal discovery foundation model CDFM, yielding scores that strongly negatively correlate with structural error and thus enable evaluating candidate causal graphs when the true structure is unknown.
